IS 4843 : 2024 Ferrous Casting - Code for Designation
ICS 77.140.80
ICS 77.140.80
MTD 14
MTD 14
1 SCOPE
This standard lays down the principles for code designation of ferrous castings.
2 REFERENCE
The standard given below contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provision of this standard. At the time of publication, the edition indicated was valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent edition of this standards:
IS 1762 (Part 1) : 1974
Code for designation of steels: Part 1 Based on letter symbols (first revision)
